test_title: PYST 2: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) PU-QN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d66a10c70a41e38668ab42be8cee8ff4face7ebfac3860895e523d2e76d1d280.png] 

Option 2) **NS-OK**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/666f02567b0937dadea2aa5bd9818b3be67b6ff8da9fcd12a3b43d9c4c6bcc7d.png] 

Option 3) LQ-MJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec4e7e73be3f69e281e16c8a0760cffbd87574a82fc7af096248cd324afcd668.png] 

Option 4) RW-SP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1d6013636fd95a6ccf1f60b5f7ee61d24e9131c55d7e44ef5a14cec9d30ceb0.png] 

Here, 'NS-OK' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
